pages.title: Charging a Lens
pages.text: Right-click a Magic Lens onto the pedestal to place it. Any mana arriving from a linked Soul Pedestal is drained into the held lens, up to its maximum capacity.
Place a Lens Pedestal within a few blocks of a Soul Pedestal to link them automatically - no wiring required. Right-click the pedestal with an empty hand to take the lens back out.
